item.title: Buffer Overflow Exploit: ROP Chain with Libc Leak
item.description: This write-up walks through a 64-bit Linux buffer overflow exploit that leaks puts() from the GOT, calculates the libc base, and then calls system("/bin/sh") using a ROP chain.
